properties.name: An idea the design has already built stops being offered as an open question
properties.statement:
When a brainstormed idea is promoted and the promotion lands — an accepted Requirement, a realized Capability, a recorded change, a rule now in force — the question it came from must stop reading as open work. The loop raises it so its owner can rule on it; closing it stays the owner's word (rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word).

TWO HALVES, because the failure has two. The promotion must DRAW the edge that records what the idea became (`EVOLVES_INTO`), and something must READ that edge. Neither alone is enough: an edge nothing reads is exactly what produced this requirement, and a reader with no edge to read is blind by construction.

Anthony's word, 2026-09-14, on being shown the triage: "Go with (a) and (b)" — (a) the instruction at the moment of promotion, (b) the detector that notices its absence.
